name: Scoped service credentials
summary: Issue, verify, expire and revoke secret service credentials.
use_when: An application admits authenticated machine requests.
proposed_guarantees: Exact owner/resource binding and explicit required scopes
Issue-once random secrets with stored SHA-256 verifiers
Mandatory expiry and revocation checked on every verification request; work already admitted may finish
Atomic create-without-overwrite and binding-checked durable revoke with bounded lock waits on supported local filesystems
Sanitized metadata listing; issuance cannot exceed a caller-authorized ceiling
failure_modes: Storage unavailable or corrupt: verification fails closed
Already admitted work may finish after revocation
Caller supplies an untrusted issuance ceiling or skips resource authorization
Local storage is not a distributed or multi-host database

evidence.basis: Candidate boundary informed by maintainer source inspection; identifying evidence is not published. No AMSL consumer adoption is claimed.
Candidate lifecycle and durable adapter source, contract tests and public-source provenance are available for review. Test fixtures are not consumer adoption.

A local integration was reported by the maintainer, but its source and artifacts are restricted and readers cannot independently reproduce it. It establishes no public AMSL adoption, merged release or production deployment.

alternatives.name: Go crypto/rand
alternatives.assessment: Use standard cryptography; AMSL may own the lifecycle integration.

alternatives.name: Existing public scoped-key and bbolt storage implementation
alternatives.assessment: Attributed persistence-pattern extraction; owner/resource authority, mandatory expiry and storage errors require an explicit hardened contract.
